title: Community and Population Health
description: Builds on students' knowledge of individual wellness and lifestyle behaviours by exploring the concepts of community and population health. Topics include: the evolution of health promotion and population health; the determinants of health; epidemiology of health behaviours; understanding and enhancing the health of children, youth, adults, seniors; principles of ecology and environmental health.
notes: Credit will be granted for only one of EPHE 351, HLTH 300, PE 351.
